gen-flavors-gf-truculenta: Flavors has diagonals as hefty as its stems, and a towering, pencil-stroke lowercase. Flavors does whimsy with authority, while Truculenta does the quieter job, packing rounded, open-sided letters into a compact sans-serif line.
gen-flavors-gf-viga: Whimsical and commanding up top, Flavors gives way to Viga, whose strokes have no hairlines or shadows at all. Long stretches read smoothly, capitals barely rising above their neighbors.
gen-flavors-gf-voces: Voces speaks in a quiet sans, its lowercase built high and its stems and hairlines close in weight. Flavors supplies the shout, and extended reading stays gentle and smooth.
gen-flavors-gf-winky-sans: Loud, rope-thick curves from Flavors up top, then Winky Sans with capitals barely taller than its lowercase. Its real charm is the modern, neutral hush that settles underneath the shouting.
gen-flavors-gf-yantramanav: Blunt, whimsical and drawn with one tip: that is Flavors. Yantramanav then sets modern, open-ended rounds with a lowercase nearly matching its capitals, giving the loudness somewhere to rest.
gen-flavors-plus-jakarta-sans: Precise and modern, Plus Jakarta Sans keeps its lowercase moderate and its curve endings apart, against Flavors' towering one. Its monoline strokes glide along steadily, never snagging on the eye.
gen-fredoka-fs-epilogue: Fredoka draws every letter with a single-width pen line and an open, gap-showing e. Epilogue joins it with wire-like monoline sans letters, curvy and unclamped, with a high lowercase and stubby ascenders.
gen-fredoka-fs-spline-sans: Fredoka keeps one pen width throughout, with an open e. Spline Sans meets that friendliness with wide gaps between curve ends and stems, and vertical and horizontal strokes of identical weight.
gen-fredoka-fs-synonym: Synonym draws dependable, clean letters with generous openings in every curve. Synonym lets Fredoka's single-width pen line and open e do the smiling while it keeps the text steady.
gen-fredoka-noto-serif: Noto Serif reads with a gentle stroke cadence and a prominent x-height, a middle path between monoline and hairline. Beside Fredoka's uniform pen line, extended reading turns warmly literary.
